descriptions.preferred: 仙女灯是澳大利亚 Yasmina 苗圃选育的一款矮生的大叶羽 团扇羽毛枫。叶型比较大叶裂很深，春天亮绿色，夏天 深绿，秋天色彩丰富，会有明亮的橙红橙黄色。成年树 高约 1.5 米。

sources.title: 仙女灯—Acer japonicum 'Fairy Lights'
sources.description: 仙女灯是澳大利亚 Yasmina 苗圃选育的一款矮生的大叶羽 团扇羽毛枫。叶型比较大叶裂很深，春天亮绿色，夏天 深绿，秋天色彩丰富，会有明亮的橙红橙黄色。成年树 高约 1.5 米。

rhs.description: A low-growing, deciduous shrub or small tree to around 1.8m tall with spreading branches. Highly dissected leaves emerge green in spring before turning brilliant shades of red, orange and yellow in autumn. Small, red spring flowers may be followed by winged fruits in autumn

attributes.suggested_uses: City/Courtyard Gardens, Flower borders and beds, Low Maintenance, Cottage/Informal Garden, Patio/Container Plants

care.cultivation: Grow in a place sheltered from cold drying winds and from late frosts, in full sun where its colours will develop best or in light dappled shade, in moist but well-drained neutral or acidic soil that does not dry out in summer or become waterlogged in winter, and protect roots with an open-textured organic mulch such as coarse bark; for more advice, see Japanese maple cultivation
care.pruning: Pruning group 1 (little or no pruning of trees and shrubs) and prune if necessary only from late autumn to midwinter
care.propagation: Propagate by grafting or softwood cuttings

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

descriptions_zh.preferred: 仙女灯是澳大利亚 Yasmina 苗圃选育的一款矮生的大叶羽 团扇羽毛枫。叶型比较大叶裂很深，春天亮绿色，夏天 深绿，秋天色彩丰富，会有明亮的橙红橙黄色。成年树 高约 1.5 米。

care.propagation: 可采用嫁接或软枝扦插繁殖
care.cultivation: 宜栽植于可避开寒冷干风和晚霜的位置；全日照下叶色表现最佳，也可在疏荫环境中栽培。土壤应保持湿润但排水良好，宜中性至酸性，夏季不宜干透，冬季不可积水。根部可覆盖疏松质地的有机覆盖物，如粗树皮，以利保湿护根。更多建议参见日本枫栽培说明。
care.pruning: 修剪组 1（树木和灌木几乎不修剪或仅少量修剪）；如确有必要，仅宜在晚秋至隆冬期间进行修剪。

resistance.pest: 可能易受槭瘿螨、蚜虫、毛虫和七叶树介壳虫危害
resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病

rhs_zh.description: 低矮生长的落叶灌木或小乔木，高约 1.8 米，枝条开展。深裂叶春季展叶时为绿色，秋季转为鲜艳的红、橙、黄色调。春季开小型红花，秋季可能结翅果。

attributes.suggested_uses: 城市/庭院花园、花境与花坛、低维护、乡村风格/自然式花园、庭院/容器植物
